name: What are popular design trends for luxury living spaces?

mainEntity.name: What are popular design trends for luxury living spaces?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current luxury living space trends often focus on creating open, airy environments that seamlessly blend indoor and outdoor living. Popular elements include natural materials like wood and stone, expansive windows for abundant light, sophisticated lighting design, and integrated smart home technology. Custom built-ins, bespoke furniture pieces, and curated art are also key to personalizing these spaces. Opus Builders stays current with these trends, offering innovative design solutions tailored to individual tastes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular luxury living space trends include open layouts, natural materials, expansive windows, sophisticated lighting, integrated smart home tech, and custom features.
